description: A normal function between conditionally complete linear orders preserves suprema of nonempty bounded-above subsets.
signature:
Order.IsNormal.map_sSup.{u_1, u_2} {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {f : α → β} [ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder α]
  [ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder β] (hf : Order.IsNormal f) {s : Set α} (hs : s.Nonempty) (hs' : BddAbove s) :
  f (sSup s) = sSup (f '' s)
